original.Body: Paul got a box of 457 erasers and 617 crayons for his birthday. At the end of the school year he only had 523 crayons left while not having lost a single eraser.
original.Question: How many more crayons than erasers did he have left?

thoughts.current:
<Step 1> Find out how many crayons Paul had at the beginning of the school year.
617 crayons - 523 crayons = 94 crayons

<Step 2> Calculate how many more crayons than erasers Paul had at the beginning of the school year.
94 crayons - 457 erasers =  -363

Answer: Paul had 363 more crayons than erasers at the beginning of the school year.
